findings.headline: The peak-seed script deletes and reinserts all peaks with fresh ids but never touches hikes, so re-running it after any hike is logged either fails on the foreign-key check or reattaches hikes to the wrong peak.
findings.plain: Updating the mountain list after logging a hike can crash the update or attach old hike notes to the wrong peak.

findings.headline: app.run() starts without threaded=True, so the server handles one request at a time and a slow weather lookup during a hike save stalls every other request.
findings.plain: Saving a hike's weather can freeze the whole app for a few seconds for anyone else using it.

findings.headline: npm dependency brace-expansion 2.0.0 - 2.1.6 || 4.0.0 - 5.0.11 has a high advisory — brace-expansion: Quadratic-time expansion of the `{a},b}` rewrite causes CPU denial of service.
npm dependency devalue <=5.9.2 has a high advisory — Svelte devalue: DoS via malformed input.
npm dependency fast-uri 3.0.0 - 3.1.7 has a high advisory — fast-uri vulnerable to host confusion via skipped IDN canonicalization on scheme-relative references.
npm dependency source-map-js 1.0.0 - 1.2.1 has a high advisory — source-map-js allows event-loop denial of service through indexed source-map section offsets.
STATUS.md unchanged across 14 commits to code since 2026-08-19 — reconcile it or confirm it still reflects reality.

The SPA fallback route checks file existence with an unsanitized, unresolved path before Flask's safe directory join runs, so a crafted URL path can reveal whether an arbitrary file exists on the host even though its contents are never returned.
findings.plain: A crafted link could reveal if a file exists elsewhere on the server.

findings.headline: npm dependency vite 8.2.0 - 8.2.2 has a high advisory — launch-editor: escapeCmdArgs() omits % escaping on Windows.
